## Pokweegee Marauder (CR 14)

A blur of tan quills streaks across the battlefield, its reptilian face locked in a perpetual grin as it darts between opponents with impossible speed.  

**XP** 38,400  
Pokweegee marauder 15  
CN Medium humanoid (extraplanar)  
**Init** +9; **Senses** Perception +20  


**Defense**


**AC** 26, touch 21, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +5 natural, +5 dodge, +1 deflection)  
**hp** 195 (15d10+45)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +16, **Will** +9  
**Defensive Abilities** evasion, defensive quills, quill shield  


**Offense**


**Speed** Speed 85 ft.  
**Melee** short sword +21/+16/+11 (1d6+6/19-20)  
**Ranged** quill volley +20 (1d8 piercing)  
**Special Attacks** sudden strike +4d6, quill volley (8/day)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 22, **Dex** 30, **Con** 16, **Int** 10, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +15; **CMB** +21, **CMD** 42  
**Feats** [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Spring Attack, Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, Run, Fleet, Nimble Moves, [Weapon Focus (short sword)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md)  
*House rules: Dodge and Mobility are one feat, Dodgility; in their place: Weapon Focus (short sword).*  
**Skills** crobatics +35, Climb +24, Perception +20, Stealth +28, Survival +20  
**Languages** Common, Pokweegee  
**SQ** fast movement (+40 ft.), lifelong growth, swift movement, technological wariness  


**Special Abilities**


**Defensive Quills (Ex)** The Pokweegee gains a +5 natural armor bonus to AC. As an immediate action when grappled, it can deal 1d4 piercing damage to the creature grappling it.  

**Quill Volley (Ex)** 8/day, 30 ft. range, 1d8 piercing damage.  

**Sudden Strike (Ex)** The Pokweegee deals an extra 4d6 damage on attacks made after using a bonus feat.  

**Swift Movement (Ex)** The Pokweegee gains Run as a bonus feat and a +10 foot racial bonus to its base speed when using the Run action.  

**Technological Wariness** +2 racial bonus on saving throws against technological effects and on Knowledge (engineering) checks to identify technological items or creatures.  

**Speed Stunts** Accelerated Attack
